claims: The Artemis II mission successfully lifted off on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission lifted off from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The Artemis II mission carried four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission had a 2-hour window starting at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launch proceeded after a brief delay for final checks.
The goal of the Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon since 1972.
The location of the Artemis II mission is NASA Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The duration of the Artemis II mission is ~10 days.
